_test.setup: cd ${HOME}/pw/dakota-tests/toy && it=$(ls -d iter_* | sort -t_ -k2 -n | tail -1) && for c in ${it}/case_*; do (cd ${c} && python3 -c "import math; v=dict((l.split()[1], float(l.split()[0])) for l in open('params.in') if l.strip()); f1=v['x1']; g=1+9*v['x2']; f2=g*(1-math.sqrt(f1/g)); open('results.out','w').write('%.10f f1\n%.10f f2\n' % (f1, f2))" && echo 0 > exit_code); done && cat ${it}/case_1/results.out
